subject: Offer elevator summary, trial eligibility wording, and AMI visibility
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@aws-partners.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Bryan Chen <bryanc@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer elevator summary, trial eligibility wording, and AMI visibility

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. Per our marketplace checklist I pulled together an initial draft of the listing content and two specific asks from the Marketplace intake:

1) Elevator summary (60-80 chars) — marketplace wants a compact one-liner we can use on the tile.
2) Trial / Private Offer eligibility language — they need exact phrasing for trials and whether PrivateOffers are allowed.
3) AMI visibility / seller-id details — ACME asked how AMI tagging will surface in the console and whether any sellerid mapping is required.

Attached is a working doc (marketplace_listing_draft_v2.docx) and a short AMI checklist (ami-tagging-checklist.pdf). Bryan from ACME is looped in for any technical clarifications.

Can you take a pass on the elevator one-liner and confirm the trial wording we should submit? If it's easier we can hop on a 20-min call later this week.

Thanks — Alicia

(attachment: marketplace_listing_draft_v2.docx, type: docx)
(attachment: ami-tagging-checklist.pdf, type: pdf)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Offer elevator summary, trial eligibility wording, and AMI visibility

Alicia —

Appreciate the draft. Looping in Kimberly to own copy tweaks and Marissa for trial/PO eligibility (she owns our marketplace ops). Quick notes:

- Elevator line: want to keep focused on what the buyer gets vs. tech (see my inline suggestion below).
- Trial language: Marissa — do we allow a 14-day trial via Private Offer or do we need to route through the standard trial SKU?
- AMI: Bryan — could you confirm whether ACME needs a public AMI or private AMI? That changes the seller-id mapping.

If Kimberly/Marissa can push a one-liner + approved trial phrase by EOD tomorrow, we can submit before the intake cutoff.

Thanks,
Rishi

Cc: Bryan Chen <bryanc@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 17:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Offer elevator summary, trial eligibility wording, and AMI visibility

Thanks for the tag, Rishi —

I reviewed the draft and pushed a few concrete copy options below. Pick whichever best fits ACME's GTM tone. I kept them short per tile constraints.

Option A (benefit-forward): "Reduce claims-processing time with on-demand LLM inference for policy extraction."
Option B (outcome-forward): "Automate claims intake and triage to cut processing time by up to 40%."
Option C (developer-friendly): "Deploy inference endpoints for secure, audit-ready policy extraction."

My recommendation: Option B for buyer-facing tile; Option A for the product page headline.

Trial language (draft that legal and marketplace prefer):
"Eligible customers may request a 14-day trial via Private Offer or the trial SKU where available. Trials are subject to approval and usage limits. Contact the seller to initiate."

AMI note (for intake form):
- If ACME needs a public AMI: provide AMI ID and we map seller-id automatically.
- Private AMI: ACME must grant account access; seller-id mapping requires our ops team to coordinate cross-account visibility.

I attached a small spreadsheet with short snippets and character counts (marketplace_snippets_v3.xlsx) — please use those exactly in the intake fields to avoid truncation errors.

Kimberly
Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

(attachment: marketplace_snippets_v3.xlsx, type: xlsx)

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer elevator summary, trial eligibility wording, and AMI visibility

Quick update from ops:

- Trial: We can support a 14-day trial via Private Offer for ACME. Ops will create a trial SKU and an entitlement that enforces a 250k token limit for the trial. Phrase Kimberly suggested is good — I recommend the slightly tightened line below to fit marketplace guidelines: 

"Eligible customers may request a 14-day trial via Private Offer or the trial SKU where available. Trials require approval and have usage limits. Contact the seller to initiate."

- AMI: ACME confirmed they prefer a private AMI. Bryan — per Kimberly's note, we'll need account IDs and the AMI manifest so our ops team can set seller-id visibility. See attached checklist for exact fields we need (ami-tagging-checklist.pdf).

Next steps:
- Rishi: if Kimberly picks the final tile/hero combo, I'll assemble the intake packet and submit to Marketplace.
- Bryan: please send account IDs + AMI manifest.

Thanks — Marissa
